diagnosis: Labeled delivery renames feedback_ref/feedback to Chinese headers; quality report is a linked 11-row table, not JSON. Neither name nor format is constrained by the business request.

transform_recipes.explanation: 将聚类分配结果映射为运营可读的三个主题（通风与温控舒适度、隔音与专注环境、预约与排期流程），输出逐条反馈的标注表。
transform_recipes.name: 场地反馈主题标注表
transform_recipes.sql:
SELECT
  lab.feedback_ref AS 反馈编号,
  lab.feedback AS 原始反馈,
  lab.cluster_label AS 主题编号,
  CASE lab.cluster_label
    WHEN 1 THEN '通风与温控舒适度'
    WHEN 2 THEN '隔音与专注环境'
    WHEN 3 THEN '预约与排期流程'
  END AS 主题名称,
  CASE lab.cluster_label
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Ventilation & thermal comfort'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Acoustic & focus environment'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Booking & scheduling flow'
  END AS 主题英文名,
  CASE lab.cluster_label
    WHEN 1 THEN '通风 气流 温度 / ventilation airflow temperature climate comfort'
    WHEN 2 THEN '隔音 安静 噪声 / acoustic quiet noise focus sound'
    WHEN 3 THEN '预约 日历 时段 / booking calendar slot schedule reserve'
  END AS 主题代表词
FROM lab
ORDER BY 主题编号, 反馈编号

transform_recipes.explanation: 汇总 k=2/3/4 三种聚类的轮廓系数、重抽样稳定度与簇规模，用于验证三个主题是否为数据支持的分组数。
